Bancassurance Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**1. Paano po mag-assign o mag-update ng beneficiary sa aking policy?**
Pwedeng mag-nominate ng asawa, mga anak, mga magulang, o kapatid bilang
beneficiary. Para mag-update, kailangan lamang mag-submit ng *Beneficiary Amendment
Form* kasama ang photocopy ng valid ID at proof of relationship (halimbawa, Birth
Certificate o Marriage Certificate). Pwedeng revocable (madaling palitan) o
irrevocable (kailangan ng pirma ng beneficiary bago baguhin).

**2. Ano po ang kaibahan ng bank deposit sa bancassurance product?**
Ang bank deposit ay savings o time deposit na may interest at insured ng PDIC
hanggang statutory limit. Ang bancassurance product naman tulad ng ProtectPlus ay

policyholder. Hindi po ito savings account, ngunit nagbibigay ng financial security.

This document contains factual, policy-grounded responses to common customer

Objection 1: "Medyo gipit ako ngayon sa budget, pwede bang i-delay muna ang hulog?"

**Grounded Response:**
Ipaliwanag po nang magalang na mayroon tayong **31-day grace period** mula sa
inyong due date kung kailan nananatiling active ang inyong coverage kahit hindi pa
nakakabayad agad. Kung masikip pa rin sa budget, may opsyon po tayong:
1. Lumipat sa monthly payment mode (halimbawa, ₱1,800/buwan para sa ₱500k plan).
2. Mag-set ng payment promise date sa loob ng 31-day window para maiwasan ang lapse.
3. Kausapin ang isang Financial Advisor para sa posibleng adjustment sa sum assured.

---

Objection 2: "Bakit pa ako kukuha ng insurance kung may savings na ako sa bangko?"

**Grounded Response:**
Mahalaga po ang savings para sa pang-araw-araw na emergency, ngunit kapag may
malubhang karamdaman o hindi inaasahang pangyayari, mabilis pong mauubos ang naipong
savings. Sa ProtectPlus plan, ang maliit na buwanang hulog (halimbawa, ₱3,500) ay
agarang nagbibigay ng **₱1,000,000 guaranteed cash benefit** sa inyong pamilya nang
hindi nagagalaw ang inyong personal na savings sa bangko.

---

Objection 3: "May hypertension o pre-existing condition ako, pwede pa ba akong mag-apply?"

**Grounded Response:**
Opo, maaari pa rin pong mag-apply! Mahalaga lamang na ideklara nang tapat ang
inyong health history sa simplified medical declaration. Ang standard life coverage
ay karaniwang naaprubahan para sa mga controlled conditions. Para naman sa Critical
Illness Rider, may standard 90-day waiting period at case-by-case review ang
underwriting team para sa pre-existing conditions.

Objection 4: "Baka mahirap mag-claim kapag may nangyari o baka scam ito?"

**Grounded Response:**
Ang Darwix ProtectPlus po ay opisyal na bancassurance partnership kasama ang
inyong pinagkakatiwalaang partner bank. Ang pag-file ng claim ay maaaring gawin
nang direkta sa kahit saang branch ng bangko o online. Kapag kumpleto ang
dokumento (Claim Form, Valid ID, Hospital SOA o Death Certificate), ang standard
processing timeline ay 5 hanggang 7 business days lamang.

chunk.text:
Overview

The automated bancassurance voice agent is designed to provide factual policy
information, collect initial screening details, answer FAQs, and handle standard
objections. It is strictly prohibited from approving policy exceptions, making
binding underwriting decisions, or negotiating settlements. When complex situations
arise, the agent must escalate immediately to a human professional.

---

chunk.text:
Mandatory Escalation Triggers (Kailan Dapat I-escalate sa Tao)

The agent must trigger immediate escalation under any of the following conditions:

1. **Direct Customer Request for a Human:**
   - When the customer explicitly asks to talk to a person, supervisor, or licensed
     advisor (*"Gusto ko pong makausap ang Financial Advisor / live agent"*).
2. **Disputed or Denied Claims:**
   - Any inquiry regarding a rejected claim, delayed claim investigation, or legal
     dispute regarding beneficiary rights.
3. **Policy Cancellation or Surrender Request:**
   - When a policyholder expresses intent to cancel an active policy or request a
     premium refund.

Lead Intake and Source

Bancassurance leads originate primarily from partner bank referrals when account
holders visit a branch, transact online, or request an initial insurance
screening call. Automated voice screening qualifies leads before transferring
them to a licensed Bancassurance Financial Advisor.

chunk.text:
Mandatory Qualification Checklist

To qualify for Darwix ProtectPlus, the candidate/client must satisfy all four (4)
baseline requirements:

1. **Age Requirement:**
   - Must be between 18 and 60 years old at the time of application.
   - Applicants age 61 and above are not eligible for new ProtectPlus policies
     (must be referred to specialized senior plans).

2. **Residency and ID Verification:**
   - Must reside in the Philippines.
   - Must be able to present at least one (1) valid Philippine government-issued ID
     (e.g., Philippine Passport, UMID, Driver's License, SSS ID, or National ID / PhilID).

Premiums (*hulog sa insurance*) are calculated based on the insured's age,
sum assured tier, and chosen riders. Standard indicative monthly premiums for a
30-year-old non-smoker:

- **Tier A (₱500,000 Sum Assured):** ~₱1,800 per month (₱21,000 annually).
- **Tier B (₱1,000,000 Sum Assured):** ~₱3,500 per month (₱40,000 annually).
- **Tier C (₱2,000,000 Sum Assured):** ~₱6,500 per month (₱75,000 annually).

Accepted Payment Channels (Saan Pwedeng Magbayad)

Clients may pay their premiums through any of the following authorized channels:

1. **Auto-Debit Arrangement (ADA):**

     prevent missed payments.

   - Enter the 10-digit Policy Number and amount.
3. **Over-The-Counter (OTC):**
   - Any 7-Eleven (via CLiQQ kiosk), Bayad Center, or SM Bills Payment counter.

chunk.text:
31-Day Grace Period (Palugit sa Pagbabayad)

- Every policy is entitled to a **31-day grace period** starting from the premium
  due date (*due date ng hulog*).
- During the 31-day grace period, the policy remains **100% active and in-force**.
- If a claim occurs within the grace period, the unpaid premium is simply deducted
  from the total death or rider payout.
chunk.title: Premium Payments, Payment Channels, Grace Period, and Lapse Policy (Synthetic)

metadata.title: Premium Payments, Payment Channels, Grace Period, and Lapse Policy (Synthetic)

chunk.text:
Policy Lapse (Pagka-lapse ng Policy)

- If the premium is not received within the 31-day grace period, the policy will
  **lapse** (*mag-la-lapse ang policy*) on day 32.
- A lapsed policy loses all insurance coverage; no benefits or claims will be
  honored for events occurring while lapsed.

chunk.text:
Policy Reinstatement (Pag-buhay muli ng Lapsed Policy)

- A lapsed policy may be reinstated within **twenty-four (24) months** from the date
  of lapse.
- Reinstatement requirements:
  1. Completion of a Health Declaration and Reinstatement Form.
  2. Settlement of all past due premiums with a minimal 0.5% monthly interest fee.
  3. Approval by underwriting.

chunk.text:
Product Overview

Darwix ProtectPlus is a synthetic bancassurance life insurance package offered
exclusively through partner bank referrals to account holders. It combines basic
life protection with optional health and accident riders to ensure comprehensive
family financial security.
chunk.title: Darwix ProtectPlus Bancassurance Plan (Synthetic)

metadata.title: Darwix ProtectPlus Bancassurance Plan (Synthetic)

chunk.text:
Core Coverage and Benefits

1. **Basic Life Insurance Benefit (Sum Assured)**
   - Provides a guaranteed lump-sum cash benefit to designated beneficiaries
     upon the untimely passing of the insured.
   - Available Sum Assured tiers:
     - Tier A: ₱500,000 (Entry level)
     - Tier B: ₱1,000,000 (Standard family protection)
     - Tier C: ₱2,000,000 (Comprehensive protection)

2. **Accidental Death and Disablement Benefit (ADB)**
   - Doubles the basic sum assured (200% payout) if demise is due to a covered
     accident.
   - Includes partial dismemberment cash benefits based on the standard
     indemnity schedule.

3. **Optional Add-on Riders**
   - **Critical Illness Rider (CI Rider):** Lump-sum cash advance equal to 50%
     or 100% of sum assured upon diagnosis of any of 36 covered major critical
     illnesses (e.g., cancer, stroke, heart attack). Subject to a 90-day waiting
